objectives: Menganalisis fungsi klausa, pilihan tenses, serta pembatas klaim dalam kalimat akademik kompleks.
Mengenali struktur yang tepat dari beberapa contoh.

blocks.text: Menganalisis fungsi klausa, pilihan tenses, serta pembatas klaim dalam kalimat akademik kompleks.
Identifikasi main clause, dependent clause, modifier, dan cakupan negasi sebelum menerjemahkan. Penghubung “although”, “because”, dan “unless” memiliki hubungan makna berbeda.
Although the sample was small, the pattern was consistent.
blocks.note: Although mengakui keterbatasan tetapi hasil tetap konsisten.

blocks.text: The findings, which were reviewed independently, suggest a trend.
blocks.note: Relative clause non-defining memberikan keterangan tambahan.

blocks.text: Unless conditions change, the plan will remain in place.
blocks.note: Unless = if not, yaitu kecuali jika kondisi berubah.

blocks.incorrect: Despite the findings were limited, we reported them.
blocks.correct: Although the findings were limited, we reported them.

blocks.text: Saat menjawab soal, perhatikan subjek dan struktur klausa terlebih dahulu, baru tentukan bentuk yang sesuai. Jangan hanya memilih jawaban karena kedengarannya familier.

practice.prompt: What does “Unless the road reopens, we will delay the trip” mean?
choices: The trip will be postponed if the road stays closed.
The trip will definitely go ahead.
The road opened because the trip was postponed.

translationId.prompt: “Unless the road reopens, we will delay the trip.” Artinya …
choices: Perjalanan ditunda jika jalan tetap tertutup.

practice.prompt: Which part of “The findings, which were reviewed, suggest a trend” adds extra information?

translationId.prompt: “The findings, which were reviewed, suggest a trend.” Bagian mana berfungsi sebagai keterangan tambahan?

choices: Although the data were limited, the conclusion was cautious.
Despite the data were limited, conclusion cautious.
Because of data were limited, the cautious.
practice.explanation: Although disusul klausa lengkap dan klausa utama.

translationId.prompt: Pilih kalimat dengan kontras yang secara tata bahasa benar.
